messages:
maya: starting thread for BankCo POC asks — they want: HSM-backed CMKs, an attestation pack for their red team, and a temporary tunnel into their VPC for 2 weeks.
vincent_sales: thanks. pricing asked if we can waive some fees during POC if they convert to Dedicated within 30d. also they want a clear option for key escrow vs customer-only keys.
nina_sec: we can provide attestation artifacts (FIPS/CC certs + firmware manifest) and a short KMS threat model doc. hsm-bot, please attach latest vendor attest bundle.
hsm-bot: attached: vendor-fips-2025.zip (redacted), firmware-manifest.txt. internal link: https://ok.redwood/sec/attestations/bankco
tom_ops: infra note: provisioning a Dedicated HSM instance with network tunnel takes ~24h for standard flow. if customer requests an offline/import ceremony add 482h. required from customer: network whitelist + ephemeral certs.
maya: can we get a concise breakdown of escrow options so I can put in an email? bullets pls (also mark which need SOW).
nina_sec: bullets: 1) No-escrow (recommended): customer retains CMK in their HSM, Redwood never stores or wraps the KEK. no SOW required. 2) Escrow-split (SOW): Redwood stores wrapped KEK parts in an HSM-backed keystore; unwrapping requires customer approval + 2-person auth. includes monthly escrow fee and audit logs. 3) Customer-wrap-backup (SOW optional): Redwood stores an encrypted backup of keys but wrapper is customer-provided and kept in customer's HSM; Redwood cannot unwrap without customer-provided unwrap token. minimal fee for storage/ops.
vincent_sales: do we have numbers for the fees? my suggested POC offer: waive the first 2 weeks of Dedicated provisioning fee if they sign a 12mo Dedicated commit within 30d. escrow-split = $2,500/mo, customer-wrap-backup = $1,000/mo. confirm?
tom_ops: those look reasonable as escalated list prices. note: escrow-split also adds an ops-oncall requirement for custodial operations (makes SRE workload higher).
maya: BankCo asked about runtime latency when using HSM for wrap/unwrap. any p99 numbers?
tom_ops: typical HSM wrap/unwrap adds ~46ms p95 and ~80ms p99 per operation for a nearby region; if tunnel crosses regions add network RTT. for signing calls (short crypto ops) expect similar delta. include that in the reply.
vincent_sales: they also want the option to schedule rotation only during business hours. is that doable?
nina_sec: yes. for Redwood-managed keys we can schedule rotations into a maintenance window. for customer-hosted keys, rotation is controlled by the customer and we coordinate. we'll note that customer-managed is recommended for regulated BankCo.
maya: they requested a sanitized tunnel snippet and the checklist of required artifacts. tom, can you paste a minimal snippet we can share?
tom_ops: paste snippet (sanitized):
```
# customer side: create VPC endpoint and allow outbound to Redwood HSM
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "rw_hsm" {
  service_name = "com.amazonaws.vpce.redwood-hsm"
  vpc_id       = "vpc-REDACTED"
}
# mTLS setup: client certs rotated via provisioning agent
# firewall: allow tcp/443 to hsm.tunnel.redwood-inference.internal
```
Note: actual ARNs/cert CNs redacted. ephemeral certs rotate every 12h by default.
maya: perfect. also need proposed SLA language for any HSM crypto latency or unavailability incidents (legal asked for remediation mechanics).
tom_ops: draft SLA line: if Redistributed HSM crypto ops exceed p99 latency target by >2x for >10 consecutive minutes, Redwood will trigger mitigation playbook: 1) failover to regional spare HSM or 2) short-term software-wrapped keys for affected tenants. For sustained >12h impact, offer a 5% monthly service credit for Dedicated plan. SRE review needed.
nina_sec: add that any escrow/unwrapping requires co-signed SOW and auditable log events. we'll provide proof-of-access logs for any recovery ops.
vincent_sales: sending email draft to BankCo with attestation pack link, 3 escrow options + fees, sanitized tunnel snippet, POC pricing & conversion credit, and proposed SLA language. CTA: ask for network whitelist and red-team availability next week.
maya: blockers: they must supply an egress IP for tunnel and sign a short AUP for red-team scan. if they insist on on-site offline ceremony, ops needs a 48h window + travel notice.
vincent_sales: noted. I'll include a timeline: aim to spin tunnel Mon, run smoke tests Tue, begin POC Wed.
maya: thanks all. label questions that require legal co-sign and tag @nina_sec for review before send. :thumbsup:
